name: zn-gate
description: For Claude Code: hooks keep secret values out of what is sent to the model (tool input, tool output and prompts), and a local MCP server checks untrusted text for prompt injection. In chat, only the guidance skill loads.

api_key.title: zn API key (optional)
api_key.description: Pro or Team API key from usezn.com/dashboard. With a key, the analyze_prompt tool also asks the zn cloud classifier and the text (secrets redacted) is sent to api.usezn.com. Leave empty to keep everything on this machine.
